    The number of boosting rounds that early stopping picks for one fold

    earlyStoppedRounds.Rd

    xgboost() takes early_stopping_rounds but does not pass it on (xgboost 3.2.1.1), so the rounds are chosen here with xgb.train(): boosting runs to xgb$nrounds, stopping once the Poisson loss of the held-out rows (evalSet) has not improved for xgb$early_stopping_rounds rounds. Training is deterministic, so fitFoldXgboost() refits with the best round as nrounds and gets that round's model.

    earlyStoppedRounds(x, y, evalSet, weight = NULL, xgb = xgbSettings())

    Arguments

    x

    Covariates (no response).

    y

    Response (label); ignitions / weight when the rows are weighted.

    evalSet

    Row indices held out of training.

    weight

    Weight of each row of x, also for the held-out rows (NULL: all 1).

    xgb

    Boosting settings, xgbSettings().

    Value

    The best round: the one with the lowest held-out Poisson loss (a number from 1 to xgb$nrounds).
